objective: Burn down the measured-defect backlog in TASKS.md: each open row re-measured before any code is written, fixed at root cause with two-sided controls, one task per commit, and the drift baseline held at exactly its standing red

criteria.description: Drift gate at its standing red: exactly 18 violations, no new check failing (19 -> 18: check_module_test_coverage drained)
Working tree clean of uncommitted residue
Both Rust workspaces build, format and test clean
criteria.command: cd tools/native && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --workspace --exclude mios-wallpaperd >/dev/null && cd ../../src/mios-rs && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --workspace >/dev/null

non_goals: Deleting any shipped component, generator, subcommand or file without the operator's explicit yes
Raising any shrink-only ratchet; a ceiling may only fall
Running a bake -- no image has been built on this branch, so no claim may depend on one
Fixing the six standing-red checks that predate this branch (they are main's, not this branch's)
